title: trying to explain mallworld to dream people
content: i find that i’m lucid throughout my mallworld dreams. i know my way around and have the same kind of storyline and circumstances/themes which always ends with everyone hating who i am in the dream and then i announce that this is actually my mallworld and i give them my full name age and where i live and tell them im not actually the person that they’ve come to hate in the dream plot line. i have severe cptsd and one of my core wounds is people thinking im bad when im trying to be good which is what always happens and i end up begging everyone to believe that this is just me dreaming and not who i really am and i find myself telling them to find me when im awake so i can prove im a good person. ive asked the people in my dreams for their names and promise ill find them but i can never remember their name or face when i wake up.
